status: Explicit physical U2 ASIC proposal and bounded numerical reference, not implemented RTL or analog-TV qualification.
profile: 625-line 50-field/s interlaced RGB plus separate composite sync; no PAL colour encoder or burst is proposed.

scope.emulator_and_public_books: Unchanged. Existing CPU-visible live beam, CSR, FIELD, register writes, display latch and epoch semantics remain owned by their current runtime.
scope.raw_words: Retained verbatim. This is one programmed profile, not a mode validator; other representable words remain deterministically sampled without clamping, rejection or black fallback.
scope.baseline: Extends design/video_baseline.json. Reset remains 628 half-lines at approximately 49.761146Hz, not this 625-half-line profile.

waveform.polarity: CSYNC low is sync tip; high is blank/reference level. RGB blanking is separate.
waveform.sample_zero: Physical line-sync leading edge at global half-line zero; local field half-line zero begins active-display traversal. Horizontal blank includes sync [0,64), back porch [64,141), active [141,843), front porch [843,864).
waveform.interval_convention: All intervals start inclusive and end exclusive. Each equalizing/broad half-line emits its pulse from that half-line leading edge; ordinary line sync occurs only at even global half-lines.
waveform.vertical_blank: Local half-lines [576,625); during ordinary portions continue global line sync. 49 half-lines =24.5 lines of VBlank plus horizontal end blanking; no claim that this reproduces every BT.470 field-blanking edge.
waveform.phase: Carry global half-line parity across every odd 625-half-line field wrap. Xn=(global_half_line&1)*N+P for source/horizontal coordinates too; never derive physical parity from the wrapped local field half-line.
waveform.epoch: Only an explicitly coherent displayed-bank restart may establish a new physical phase origin. A field wrap does not reset it. This does not alter CPU-live beam/FIELD/CSR ownership.

pipeline_alignment.common_frontend: Coordinate, memory, decode, RGB and sync tags share all front-end latency. Eight samples in video_baseline is a memory-model request-to-output budget, not complete pin latency.
pipeline_alignment.edge_reference: Let time0 be the falling VIDEO_PCLK edge when U2 launches a tagged RGB/control sample. U35 captures that sample at the next rising edge,T/2. Its one-clock pipeline presents the corresponding analog output about3T/2+t6 after the U2 launch. Reference CSYNC delay to that same U2 falling launch, not to a different DAC capture edge.
pipeline_alignment.dac: ADV7125 RevD Tables3/4 specify tPD=1clock. T=74.074074ns at13.5MHz; t6 is typically5.5ns at5V or7.5ns at3.3V. Thus the falling-U2-launch to RGB analog50% target is approximately116.61ns at5V or118.61ns at3.3V, before RGB board/buffer delays.
pipeline_alignment.compensation: U2 CSYNC bypasses U35. Account total latency from the same U2 falling launch:RGB captureT/2 + DAC pipelineT + t6; versus U42 + RC + video-filter/amp + PCB/load. Initial candidate uses the same falling launch with NO extra whole-sample CSYNC register:nominal ideal sync112.002ns is close to RGB116.611ns at5V or118.611ns at3.3V. Close remaining path terms by characterization and loaded-connector measurement, not by blindly adding aDAC sample.
pipeline_alignment.sync_analog_path: Canonical circuit owner:design/video_output.json. U42 light-load3.3V buffer -> R53336.5k/R5343.83k divider+C53318pF -> U43 THS7314 CH1 -> R52875ohm -> SCART_CSYNC. This profile does not own the circuit or duplicate its component model.
pipeline_alignment.analog_delay: Use the current video-circuit response report for the conditional input-RC and ideal-filter delay. It already includes both stages; do not add a separate guessed group delay. Manufacturer group delay is not a guaranteed step-edge delay.
pipeline_alignment.prototype_acceptance: At the loaded SCART connector, measure correspondingly tagged RGB blanking and CSYNC edges from the same U2 falling launch. Select fixed path compensation for <=one13.5MHz sample(74.074ns) residual relative displacement, and verify64/32/368-sample pulse widths at50% amplitude. This is an explicit prototype acceptance target, not a met result.

references.use: Studied before implementation: mature DRM separates encoder configuration from scan timing and explicitly associates625/50 with864 horizontal samples; do not copy its mode rejection into raw-register hardware.
Primary waveform reference:625 systems64us lines; five half-line pulses each pre/equalizing,broad,post; nominal4.7us/2.35us/27.3us pulses. BT.470-7 delegates signal characteristics to BT.1700.
RevD Tables3/4 and Figure2:one-cycle pipeline,t6 output delay,latched RGB/SYNC/BLANK; direct CSYNC bypass must be compensated.
